parsed.explanation: Reduced-risk tier. No trans-specific criminal offence, no facility or border exclusion, and no documented targeting of trans visitors by police. Self-declaration gender recognition is in force, and discrimination on gender identity is prohibited. The 2023 conversion-practice ban and a 2014 hate-motivated murder conviction show courts treating anti-LGBT violence seriously. Negatives: a documented dating-app ambush-robbery pattern that travellers could meet, though the record centres on gay men. A capital-region certificate requirement conflicts with national law, but nothing shows it reaching visitors. Mainly LGBT-wide harassment figures from the late 2010s, which I gave little weight as current trans prevalence. The absence of a statutory hate-crime definition weakens recourse. Visitor-facing protections and documented acceptance outweigh these, leaving the score in the reduced-risk band.
